t: You're on Trevor Place, a street in the City of Westminster. It is named after Sir John Trevor, a Welsh lawyer and politician who lived from 1637 to 1717. He was Speaker of the House of Commons from 1685 to 1687, and again from 1689 to 1695, and he served as Master of the Rolls. His second term as Speaker ended over a bribery allegation, and he was expelled from the Commons shortly afterwards. The material I have says little else about the street itself.
